systems.owner: Civil Registry Department with UNICEF, funded by Sweden and the Swiss Agency for Development Co-operation
systems.tiers: hard-to-reach areas of Binga district (Sinamusanga, Tshunga-lunga); IDs, birth and death certificates issued on site

note: A mobile registration exercise in Binga described by the ministry as a targeted outreach mechanism: a campaign, not an office; the article does not say how the records were made. It cites birth registration coverage of 57% (ZDHS 2023-24).
